USDOT Issues Guidance on Mobile Driver's License Acceptance at Transportation Facilities

October 8, 2026

WASHINGTON – The U.S. Department of Transportation today issued guidance describing how transportation facilities may accept mobile driver's licenses that meet the published security standard.

“Travelers want to carry their credentials on their phones, and states want clear rules,” said Deputy Secretary Theodore Ashgrove.

The guidance takes effect January 15, 2027, and applies to credentials issued by states that have completed certification.
